meta.name: documentation
meta.description: Documentation standards for ARCHITECTURE.md, PLAN.md, DESIGN.md, SPECS.md, SKILL.md, diagrams, and README indexing. Use when creating or updating project documentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按标准格式创建和维护项目文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中建立统一的文档标准
copy.tagline_en: Create and maintain project documentation with standard formats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish consistent documentation standards in your project

howto.what: Claude 会在编码或执行前，先更新项目文档，包括架构、计划、设计、规格、技能说明和图表等，并确保 README 索引所有永久文档。
howto.when: 当创建或更新项目文档时触发，尤其是在开始编码或运行 `gopush` 之前。

say.text: 帮我更新 ARCHITECTURE.md，描述新模块的抽象设计。
say.note: Claude 会按标准格式编写架构文档。

say.text: 为这个功能创建 PLAN.md，包含开发规则和步骤。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含约束和测试策略的计划。

say.text: 在 README 中添加 docs/ 下所有永久文档的链接。
say.note: Claude 会更新索引，排除临时文件。

howto.what_en: Claude updates project documentation before coding or execution, including architecture, plan, design, specs, skill files, and diagrams, and ensures README indexes all permanent docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating or updating project documentation, especially before starting to code or running `gopush`.

say_en.text: Update ARCHITECTURE.md to describe the new module's abstract design.
say_en.note: Claude writes the architecture doc per standard format.

say_en.text: Create a PLAN.md for this feature with development rules and steps.
say_en.note: Claude generates a plan with constraints and test strategy.

say_en.text: Add links to all permanent docs in docs/ to the README.
say_en.note: Claude updates the index, excluding ephemeral files.
